description: Defines the ScaffoldOptions class for managing project scaffold configuration options in Drupal, including allowed packages, locations, symlink settings, and file mappings.

classes.name: ScaffoldOptions
classes.description: A class for handling scaffold options from composer.json's 'drupal-scaffold' section, including default settings, overrides, and accessors.

methods.name: hasOptions
methods.description: Checks if the 'extras' array contains 'drupal-scaffold' options.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a ScaffoldOptions instance from the 'extras' array.

methods.name: override
methods.description: Returns a new ScaffoldOptions instance with overridden options.

methods.name: overrideSymlink
methods.description: Overrides the 'symlink' setting in the scaffold options.

methods.name: hasAllowedPackages
methods.description: Checks if allowed packages are defined.

methods.name: allowedPackages
methods.description: Retrieves the list of allowed packages.

methods.name: hasLocation
methods.description: Checks if a specific location name exists.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a specific location name.

methods.name: symlink
methods.description: Checks if symlink mode is enabled.

methods.name: hasFileMapping
methods.description: Checks if file mappings are defined.
